title: Kidney-Genetics: A reproducible and curated database of kidney-related genes
description: Kidney-Genetics compiles a curated database of kidney-related genes from PanelApp, literature, clinical diagnostic panels, Human Phenotype Ontology annotations, and PubTator. R analysis scripts merge and annotate these sources, and bookdown documentation presents the resulting gene tables.
